mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 5% over two consecutive quarters signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which reduces corporate borrowing and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of quarters when FEDFUNDS > 5% for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of quarters with YoY GDPC1 decline exceeding 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as profit margins compress.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 5-day forward returns in more than 70% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in INDPRO and a fall in HOUST over the same month indicates supply chain inflation with reduced housing affordability, which erodes consumer purchasing power and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > previous month AND HOUST < previous month in the same month
regime_hint: supply chain stress with housing affordability decline
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during months satisfying the INDPRO/HOUST condition.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in RSAFS above its 12-month moving average by more than 10% signals robust retail demand, which correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days in expansionary regimes.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 12-month moving average +10% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly above median in periods where RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average by more than 10% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and a rise in CPIAUCSL above 3% over two months signals a loss of monetary control, which increases inflation uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous month AND CPIAUCSL > 3% in the same month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during episodes of falling FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL > 3% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent fall in PAYEMS below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals weakening employment, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < 12-month moving average for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly below median during periods of four consecutive months with PAYEMS below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 and INDPRO above their respective 6-month moving averages signals synchronized demand and supply expansion, which boosts earnings expectations and results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly above median when both GDPC1 and INDPRO exceed their 6-month moving averages in the same month.
